a.address_statement: The museum is at Paul Sacher-Anlage 1, 4058 Basel. Its official site lists the phone as +41 61 681 93 20 ... (Second search: The official site lists Paul Sacher-Anlage 1, 4058 Basel, with the museum phone at +41 61 681 93 20.)

a.address_statement: Its general address is Ruchfeldstrasse 19, CH-4142 Münchenstein, with phone +41 61 335 32 32 and email info@schaulager.org (Schaulager, Ruchfeldstrasse 19, CH-4142 Münchenstein / Basel).
